name: Transport and storage

bnote.491100: Passenger rail in India is run by Indian Railways, which is not listed. IRCTC runs its ticketing and catering. Japan's JR companies and Hong Kong's MTR are listed rail operators.
bnote.491201: CONCOR runs container trains in India. The four largest North American freight railroads follow.
bnote.492301: TCI and VRL are India's listed trucking companies.
bnote.501200: India's two listed shipping companies, plus Maersk and Hapag-Lloyd.
bnote.511001: IndiGo and SpiceJet are India's listed airlines. Air India and Akasa are private.
bnote.523100: Allcargo is India's listed freight forwarder. The rest are the largest forwarders abroad.
bnote.523201: Ola is not listed. Uber, Grab and Lyft are the main listed ride-hailing platforms.
bnote.532001: Blue Dart and Delhivery are India's listed express carriers.

flags.lyft: Net profit includes a large one-time tax benefit, so net margin and P/E are not operating results.
flags.geship: Net profit is above EBITDA because of asset-sale gains and other income.
flags.gmrairport: Airport companies carry heavy debt during expansion, so profit is thin relative to EBITDA.
flags.interglobe: Net profit in the latest twelve months is negative because of large foreign-exchange losses on lease liabilities; EBITDA stays strong.

notes: India has listed companies for rail containers, ports, airlines, trucking, couriers and cold storage. Pipelines, cruises and ride-hailing use companies abroad.
